article.title_es: Consulado General de México en Nueva York: consulado en Manhattan
article.title_en: Consulate General of Mexico in New York: consulate in Manhattan
article.summary_es: El Consulado General de México en Nueva York es un consulado del gobierno de México, ubicado en Manhattan. Atiende de lunes a viernes, y por las tardes con cita previa.
article.summary_en: The Consulate General of Mexico in New York is a consulate of the government of Mexico, located in Manhattan. It is open Monday to Friday, and in the afternoons by appointment.
how_they_help_es: Es un consulado del gobierno de México en la ciudad de Nueva York.
Está ubicado en 27 East 39th Street, Nueva York, NY 10016, en Manhattan.
Abre de lunes a viernes de 8am a 1pm, y de 3pm a 7pm con cita.
Puede llamar al (212) 217 6400 para preguntar por sus servicios.
Los servicios específicos y las reglas de citas no están en esta información; pregunte directamente.
how_they_help_en: It is a consulate of the government of Mexico in New York City.
It is located at 27 East 39th Street, New York, NY 10016, in Manhattan.
It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 1pm, and from 3pm to 7pm with an appointment.
You can call (212) 217 6400 to ask about its services.
Specific services and appointment rules are not listed here; ask directly.
visit_tips_es: Las visitas por la tarde (3pm a 7pm) requieren cita previa.
Llame al (212) 217 6400 antes de ir para confirmar qué necesita.
La información fue verificada por última vez el 10 de octubre de 2026.
visit_tips_en: Afternoon visits (3pm to 7pm) require an appointment.
Call (212) 217 6400 before going to confirm what you need.
This information was last checked on October 10, 2026.

faq_es.a: Esta información no detalla los servicios. Llame al (212) 217 6400 o consulte la fuente oficial para saber qué ofrece.
Por la mañana (8am a 1pm) no se indica si se necesita cita. Por la tarde (3pm a 7pm) sí es con cita previa.
Está en 27 East 39th Street, Nueva York, NY 10016, en Manhattan. Abre de lunes a viernes de 8am a 1pm y de 3pm a 7pm con cita.

faq_en.q: What services does this consulate offer?
faq_en.a: This information does not list the services. Call (212) 217 6400 or check the official source to find out what it offers.

faq_en.q: Do I need an appointment to visit?
faq_en.a: For mornings (8am to 1pm), it is not stated whether an appointment is needed. For afternoons (3pm to 7pm), an appointment is required.

faq_en.q: Where is it and what are the hours?
faq_en.a: It is at 27 East 39th Street, New York, NY 10016, in Manhattan. It is open Monday to Friday from 8am to 1pm and from 3pm to 7pm with an appointment.
